column1: # AUTO-GENERATED by tools/build_surface_confidence.py -- DO NOT EDIT, re-emit.
# How sure we are WHERE each progression-surface class lives.
# 'eligible' = checks that may actually HOST progression: tagged, minus every bar below.
# A TAG COUNT IS NOT A HOSTING COUNT. Both are printed; quote the second one.
# 'total' IS ALREADY FILTERED, AND THAT USED TO BE INVISIBLE. It is contract.has_class:
# checks carrying the tag MINUS checks carrying a SURFACE_EXCLUDE_TAG (EniaShop -- Enia's
# buy-only remembrance store). The 'checks N carry any tag' line below is RAW. So the two
# numbers on this page legitimately disagree, and nothing said so.
#   raw tag count for a class  ==  total + tag_excluded
# MOTIVATING CASE (rule 11): on 2026-08-08 an agent read `Shop 500` here, measured 527 raw
# tags in location_tags.py, and reported the committed table as STALE in a design review.
# It was not stale -- test_gf_surface_confidence::test_artifact_is_current diffs a fresh
# emit on every CI run and was green. Two measures, one label, a fabricated defect. The
# column makes the filter visible instead of leaving it in prose.
#   tag_excluded      carries the tag but also a SURFACE_EXCLUDE_TAG -> never on the surface
#   guessed_region    region defaulted/tile-guessed -> AP thinks it is reachable at spawn
#   missable          can be lost permanently -> cannot be required
#   erdtree_burn      m11_00 destroyed when Maliketh dies (CONDITIONAL: not barred when the
#                     capital reconciler is armed -- see the two default_hosting_* lines)
#   surface_excluded  hand-excluded surface-tagged checks (gen_data _SURFACE_EXCLUDE_FLAGS)
#   hub_merchant      Roundtable-Hold ShopSlots -- reachable at spawn, so trivial
# Bar columns OVERLAP (one check can be both guessed and missable), so they do not sum to
# total - eligible. 'eligible' is computed from the UNION, never by subtracting the columns.
# 🛑 This table sets NO policy. It prices each class; a human decides what is offerable.
# 🛑 A class is not safe because its items were audited to EXIST. Golden Seeds are 43/43
#    audited for existence and several still have a GUESSED region -- a different claim,
#    and the one the surface depends on. See the Seedtree row.
